verdict.rationale: Reporting dashboards are a fair axis for a work-management product like Asana, but the evidence pack never documents native dashboards or widgets for reporting on project progress. The closest items do not count: an API tutorial for building your own status-update report is a developer building block, MCP 'generate reports and summaries' is an adjacent AI feature, and Fivetran export to BI tools is a third-party workaround.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build dashboards and widgets to report on project progress
